title: KeyBlocker
description: KeyBlocker lets you choose specific keyboard keys to disable while playing Minecraft. Configure it through Mod Menu, search the full key list, and toggle keys between allowed and disabled without affecting chat or other menus.
body:
# KeyBlocker

KeyBlocker is a client-side Fabric mod that lets you disable specific keyboard keys while you are playing Minecraft. It is made for players who want more control over their keyboard, whether that means blocking keys they press by accident, stopping unwanted movement inputs, disabling annoying binds, or making their setup feel cleaner during gameplay.

The mod is fully configurable through **Mod Menu**. Inside the config screen, you get a clean searchable list of keyboard keys. Each key can be toggled between **Allowed** and **Disabled** with one click. When a key is disabled, KeyBlocker prevents it from working during normal gameplay.

KeyBlocker is designed to be safe and simple to use. Disabled keys are only blocked while you are actively playing in-game. They still work normally in chat, menus, inventory screens, settings screens, and the KeyBlocker config itself, so you do not lock yourself out of typing or changing settings.

## Features

- Disable individual keyboard keys
- Searchable key list
- One-click toggle for each key
- Clean Mod Menu config screen
- Shows each key as Allowed or Disabled
- Blocks keys only during gameplay
- Still allows typing in chat and menus
- Works client-side
- Saves your disabled key list automatically
- Includes a custom logo
- Made for Minecraft 1.21.11

## How It Works

Open Mod Menu, find **KeyBlocker**, and open the config screen. Search for the key you want to block, then click it to disable it. Click it again to allow it.

Once disabled, that key will no longer trigger normal gameplay actions while you are playing. If you open chat, a menu, or another screen, the key works normally again.

## Important

This mod is client-side and affects only your own controls. It does not change server behavior and does not affect other players.

## Info

- Mod name: KeyBlocker
- Minecraft version: 1.21.11
- Loader: Fabric
- Author: BestOfAfrika
